verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The PR adds `__slots__ = (('_markers',))` to `Marker` as a performance change (see PR title and added line). This change breaks backward compatibility for pickled `Marker` objects: an instance pickled by the old class (without `__slots__`) cannot be unpickled by the new class, raising `AttributeError`. The PR has no tests, docs, or changelog entry addressing pickling, so the regression is unintended.
evidence: None: this PR changes no tests, docs or changelog.
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["\"b\" > \"a\""], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.AttributeError.
